textures: Use existing 'grain' utility class for backgrounds to add tactile luxury.
glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A192F]/80' for sticky headers or floating navs. Never use fully transparent.
borders: Use delicate 1px borders of 'border-[#C9CCD3]/20' for cards and sections to establish clinical precision.

header.style: Sticky, glassmorphism (bg-[#0A192F]/80 backdrop-blur-md), z-50. Do not use fully transparent background.

hero_section.title: Il workspace clinico d'élite per il medico specialista: zero burocrazia, massima precisione
hero_section.style: Center-aligned text but asymmetrical background/layout. Generous padding (py-32 or py-48), dark background with platinum text.

features_bento.style: Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3). Tight gaps, subtle hover lift, platinum borders. Avoid generic symmetric cards.

security_section.content: Crittografia AES-256, server EU (Frankfurt), 2FA, informed consent, access log.
security_section.style: Technical, prudent wording (no 'conformità totale'). Grid borders, monospaced accents for security specs.

contact_form.style: Minimalist inputs, clear labels. Use Shadcn customized for dark luxury.

motion.entrance: Framer Motion for staggered fade-in up on scroll.
motion.interactions: Subtle button scaling and brightness increase on hover. No 'transition: all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white/platinum text on #0A192F meets APCA/WCAG standards.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

image_urls.description: Minimalist dark texture for subtle hero background depth
Doctor portrait to use in about or trust sections if needed

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the landing page at '/' and ensure the 'Accedi' button links to '/app'.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts, heavily customized Shadcn components for interactive logic (Forms, Select, Buttons).
Maintain the elite 'Boutique Medica' vibe: absolutely no generic SaaS blues or playful colors.
Do not use complete transparent background in header; use glassmorphism with the night blue color.
Adhere to the exact Italian copy provided for the hero and GDPR sections.
Form fields must include informed consent for privacy.
Do NOT create .tsx files. The instructions apply to .js frontend files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
Do not center-align the app container via App class in CSS.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Ensure layering through z-index and backdrop filters.
No emojis for icons. Use lucide-react or configured icon library.
All interactive elements and informational elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-form-submit-button').
Use sonner for toasts if needed.
